title: Empery Digital Repurchases 194,625 Shares Under Buyback Program
summary: Empery Digital repurchased 194,625 shares in the week ended November 13, 2026, for a total of 26,880,973, with about $49 million left in its program.
body_markdown:
As of November 13, 2026, the company said it has repurchased an aggregate of 26,880,973 shares of its common stock, a total the release headline gives as approximately 26.9 million shares. Following these repurchases, Empery Digital said it has 29,177,481 shares outstanding, after giving effect to the potential exercise of 1,653,686 pre-funded warrants, and that approximately $49 million remains available under the share repurchase authorization.


## Why It Matters for EMPD


The update gives the program's running totals: the cumulative number of shares bought back, the share count that remains outstanding after those purchases, and the amount still available under the $200 million authorization, which the company puts at approximately $49 million.


According to the release, Empery Digital is focused on building long-term shareholder value through what it calls a disciplined capital allocation strategy. The company said it employs a bitcoin treasury strategy and is expanding into AI infrastructure and data center investments. In its forward-looking statements, the company lists its stock repurchase plans and the benefits of repurchases of its shares among matters subject to risks and uncertainties, and it notes that its stock price may be highly correlated to the price of the digital assets it holds.
